description.short: Evidence-backed product improvement and new product ideas.
description.full: ProductIQ analyses customer feedback, market trends, cost, supplier availability and logistics (Microsoft Fabric + Foundry IQ) to propose ranked product options with a scorecard and citations. With your approval it sets up a Teams meeting and project chat, joins it and keeps the project memory so nobody has to re-explain the work. Demo uses synthetic Contoso Home Appliances data.

disclaimer.text: ProductIQ demo – synthetic data. AI-generated content may be incorrect; numbers are cited from Fabric data. Actions like meetings and chats run only after your approval.
